messages:
Priya: starting blue/green for embedserve v2026.04.01-green, staged ramp 15% global. change window 05:00-06:00 UTC. release notes: https://confluence.redwood/embedserve/2026.04.01 :rocket:
Deploy-bot: Deploy kickoff (job=efg789). Command: `rd-deploy start --service embedserve --version v2026.04.01-green --strategy bluegreen --staged 15%`
Deploy-bot: Router change queued: `routerctl set-weight embedserve green 0.15`
Ben: spotted p99 tail spikes in ap-southeast1 within ~8m of the shift (baseline 380ms -> 820ms). Mostly inference pipeline enqueue delays.
Sam: ok hold global ramp at 15%. Can we exclude ap-southeast from canary so other regions can continue?
Lina: yes we can. Applying region exclude and pin ap-southeast to blue for now. `routerctl set-weight embedserve green 0.00 --region ap-southeast1 && routerctl set-cookie-affinity embedserve blue --region ap-southeast1`
Deploy-bot: Region exclusion applied: ap-southeast1 green=0.00, cookie-affinity blue set (ap-southeast1). Global staged remains 15% for other regions.
Priya: thanks. I'm expanding canary logs and toggling async batcher debug on green pods in staging to reproduce. Also bump healthcheck to 6m for green.
Ben: error-rate there mostly 500-from-worker queue full, not OOM. traces show slow redis ack under high concurrency. Might be connection pool sizing.
Sam: we should avoid full rollback. Plan: 1) keep ap-southeast pinned to blue, 2) proceed limited rollforward in na and eu, 3) add header-based pin for internal traffic only so we can get production-like traffic without impacting external users.
Lina: header pinning is ready. `routerctl set-weight embedserve green 0.15 --header "x-internal-canary=true"` will direct internal requests matching header to green at 15% while external stays unaffected.
Deploy-bot: Header-based route applied: x-internal-canary -> green 15%.
Priya: starting regional rollforward: allow us-central and eu-west1 to move to green 30% to reduce variance and validate steady-state. Command: `routerctl set-weight embedserve green 0.30 --region us-central1,eu-west1`
Deploy-bot: Region weights updated: us-central1 green=0.30, eu-west1 green=0.30. Global auto-ramp remains throttled.
Ben: observing p95/p99 improve in eu and na, no additional errors in these regions. ap-southeast still stable on blue.
Sam: good. Lina, add a temporary router policy to cap global auto-ramp to 25% until memory/network diagnostics are completed. `routerctl set-policy embedserve auto-ramp-threshold 0.25 --ttl 2h`
Lina: policy applied.
Priya: documenting: release notes updated -> "partial rollout: ap-southeast excluded due to queueing regression; header-internal canary enabled; targeted rollforward in us/ eu. Follow-up: investigate redis pool interactions and batcher concurrency tuning"
Deploy-bot: Notifying support and retention: Support-pager queued and release notes annotated.
Ben: opening ticket ENG-6721 for redis pool tuning + reproduction, assigning to infra and runtime teams.
Sam: next steps: reproduce in staging with load shape that mimics ap-southeast traffic, try increasing redis pool and client backpressure, then re-run green in ap-southeast behind a slow ramp if stable.
Priya: agreed. For now we'll keep this thread open for 2h observation, but set alert thresholds to louder notifications for p99 and 5xx in excluded regions so we can react if anything changes.
Lina: alert channel wired, escalation set to oncall if p99>600ms or 5xx>1% in any region.
Ben: all good here. thanks team.
Priya: thanks. I'll close this after the 2h observation window if stable.
